name: PositionAttribute
description: What a Position WAS, over a date range: its title and its territory. Effective-dated, so a credit rule asking 'what territory was seat POS-07 in on 2026-03-14' gets the answer that was true then, not the answer that is true now. Exactly one row must match any given date - two matches is a data bug the calculation raises rather than picks between. Territory is a LOOKUP to Territory: credit rules match on it, and a rule matching 'WEST' against a seat typed 'West' pays nobody, silently.
